prompts.receipt: What is the final total amount shown on this receipt? Return only the amount, with no currency symbol, label, or explanation.
prompts.resume: What is the highest degree level stated in this resume? Return exactly one label from: secondary, certificate_or_diploma, associate, bachelor, postgraduate, master, doctorate.
prompts.receipt_localize_relative: Locate the final transaction total and its label on this receipt. Exclude subtotal, tax, cash tendered and change. Return only JSON {"box":[left,top,right,bottom]} using coordinates from 0 to 1000 relative to the full image. Include the total label and its amount in one tight box. If no total can be located, return {"box":null}.
prompts.resume_localize_pixels: Find the education and qualifications sections on this resume page. Locate whole sections, including their headings, degree or diploma names, institutions, dates and any continuation lines. Include stated qualifications even if the page does not explicitly say completed or awarded. Include education entries outside a heading too. Do not infer qualifications from job titles, work experience or skills. Group nearby lines in the same section into one box rather than returning a box per word or line. Return only JSON in this exact format: {"boxes": [[left, top, right, bottom]]}. Use pixel coordinates on the displayed image of width {w} and height {h}. Return {"boxes": []} only if no education or qualification entries are visible. Return at most four section boxes. Do not include explanations or transcribed text.
